title: A deleted debt runs its Retire check in the merge preview
why: A debt can't be closed by deleting its file while its gap stays open.
note: Coordinator 12:57 CST Nov 6, from the verdicts-without-challenger audit (Opus Explore): a PR that deletes a debt runs that debt's Retire check in the merge preview; a red or unread check refuses. Measured: 35 debt deletes since Oct 23, 9 of them md-only. No model call. Lane started (coordinator).
